title: VP of Sales

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: With Nazdar SourceOne distribution across 14+ locations serving specialty graphic and textile printing industries, the VP of Sales leads a large team selling into sign shops, print service providers, vehicle wrap installers, and OEM partners. This role is measured on revenue growth, market share gains, and customer retention in competitive ink and supplies markets. Offering Tedlar as a recommended protective overlaminate creates a consultative sales approach that positions Nazdar as a complete solution provider, not just an ink supplier. When customers complain about premature graphic failures, warranty claims, or UV degradation—common pain points in outdoor applications—the sales team can offer a proven solution that protects both the customer's investment and Nazdar's reputation. This role would also appreciate how Tedlar's extreme durability reduces customer churn by eliminating performance failures, while the graffiti resistance feature opens new market opportunities in transit, municipalities, and high-vandalism environments where current solutions fail.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: The VP of Sales owns revenue generation across Nazdar's 14+ SourceOne distribution locations, managing sales teams that serve sign shops, print service providers, vehicle wrap installers, and OEM partners. This role has direct authority over go-to-market strategy, sales team enablement, customer retention initiatives, and product portfolio positioning. They report to the CEO or President and likely oversee Regional Sales Directors, Key Account Managers, and Technical Sales Specialists. Their decisions directly impact which products get featured in customer conversations, how sales reps bundle solutions, and which strategic partnerships get prioritized for driving revenue growth.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Given Nazdar's customer base, three Tedlar use cases are immediately relevant: (1) Fleet graphics and vehicle wraps—Nazdar's 3500 Series inks serve this market where customers demand extended warranties and protection from UV degradation, road debris, and frequent washing; (2) Outdoor signage and architectural graphics—their 2800 and 270 Series inks are marketed for outdoor durability, but currently only support 2-3 year warranties, limiting competitiveness against premium solutions; (3) Transit and municipal graphics—an underserved opportunity where graffiti resistance is critical and Nazdar currently lacks a protective overlaminate recommendation. Pairing Nazdar's inks with Tedlar would transform their sales pitch from 'durable ink' to 'complete outdoor graphics system with industry-leading protection,' directly addressing customer pain points around premature failures while opening new market segments.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This VP is measured on quarterly and annual revenue targets, market share growth in competitive ink markets, customer retention rates, and sales team performance metrics. Their personal success depends on equipping sales reps with differentiated solutions that close deals and reduce customer churn. Current pain points likely include: (1) losing deals to competitors offering more comprehensive outdoor protection systems; (2) fielding customer complaints about graphic failures that damage Nazdar's reputation and create service costs; (3) difficulty justifying premium pricing when competitors offer similar 2-3 year durability claims; (4) limited ability to penetrate high-value transit and municipal segments that demand graffiti-proof solutions. Tedlar solves all four problems by enabling Nazdar's team to sell complete, differentiated systems with dramatically superior performance claims, protecting both customer investments and Nazdar's brand while opening new revenue streams.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Nazdar exhibited at PRINTING United Expo 2024 in September and ISA Sign Expo 2024, indicating active engagement in the graphics community and likely fresh customer feedback from these events. Their recent sustainability awards (2024 TLMI Calvin Frost Trailhead Award and 2024 EcoVadis Silver Medal) suggest the company is emphasizing quality and environmental responsibility in their positioning—Tedlar's reduced replacement frequency fits this narrative perfectly. The company's OEM partnership with M&R Printing Equipment announced in 2023 demonstrates they're actively building strategic relationships to differentiate their offering. With Q1 2025 approaching, this is ideal timing to introduce a partnership that could be integrated into 2025 sales planning, trade show strategy for upcoming events, and customer-facing materials for the new year.

personalization_hooks.hook: Nazdar's current outdoor durability claims (2-3 years for 2800, 3500, and 270 Series) limit competitiveness in premium fleet graphics and architectural markets where customers demand extended warranties
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as the missing piece that transforms Nazdar's positioning from '2 years outdoor durability' to '12-20+ years with recommended protective system'—giving their sales team a dramatic competitive advantage without reformulating existing ink lines

personalization_hooks.hook: Nazdar SourceOne's 14+ distribution locations serve customers who frequently complain about premature graphic failures, UV degradation, and warranty claims—problems that damage customer relationships and create service costs
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar as a customer retention tool that protects Nazdar's reputation and reduces churn by eliminating the performance failures that currently erode trust with sign shops and vehicle wrap installers

personalization_hooks.hook: As VP of Sales leading teams into transit, municipal, and high-visibility outdoor applications, they need a graffiti-resistant solution to compete in segments where vandalism makes current offerings fail
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Present Tedlar's graffiti resistance as opening entirely new market opportunities in transit, government, and outdoor advertising—segments Nazdar's sales team currently struggles to penetrate due to lack of protective overlaminate recommendation

recommended_approach: Lead with the complete solution positioning angle—emphasize how Tedlar transforms Nazdar from an ink supplier into a comprehensive outdoor graphics system provider. Frame the conversation around competitive differentiation and revenue growth, not just product features. Reference their recent trade show presence and position this as a strategic partnership discussion for 2025 planning.
